name: reachinbox-email-scheduler
description: Production-quality Full-Stack Email Job Scheduler - Milestone 1 Foundation

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "API,WORKER,WEB" -c "blue,cyan,green" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web && npm run build:worker
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@reachinbox/api && npm run test --workspace=@reachinbox/worker
